definitions.explanation: Mail sent by airplane, typically for international correspondence. Faster but more expensive than surface mail.
Goods or packages transported by airplane, as opposed to sea freight or overland transport.

examples.japanese: {航空便|こうくうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
{航空便|こうくうびん}なら⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It will arrive in a week by airmail.

examples.english: Fresh food is often transported by air freight.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{航空|こうくう}→航空：02798_koukuu⟧ ('aviation; air') and ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ ('mail service; delivery; flight'). The standard term used at post offices and shipping companies for air transport of mail or cargo.

USAGE:
- At a Japanese post office, when sending international mail you will be asked to choose between {航空便|こうくうびん} and ⟦{船便|ふなびん}→船便：20345_funabin⟧ ('surface mail; sea mail').
- The word also applies to commercial cargo shipped by air, as opposed to ⟦{船便|ふなびん}→船便：20345_funabin⟧ or {陸便|りくびん} ('overland transport').
- On envelopes and packages, often written in the abbreviated form エアメール (from English 'airmail') or marked with the French-origin label PAR AVION.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {航空便|こうくうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send by airmail
- {航空便|こうくうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to arrive by airmail
- {航空便|こうくうびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: airmail postage
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{航空便|こうくうびん}: international airmail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{船便|ふなびん}→船便：20345_funabin⟧: surface mail; sea mail — slower and cheaper alternative using ships
- エアメール: airmail — English loanword used interchangeably, especially in casual contexts
- ⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧: express delivery — domestic express mail service, different from airmail
- ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧: mail; post — the general term for postal service
